raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Deployed and trained ML models on AWS & GCP, and ensuring scalable cloud-based solutions.
Built TensorFlow models for object detection and image processing.
Developed NLP solutions (NER tagging, text summariza- tion, recommendation systems, sentiment analysis).
Performed	EDA	&	data	visualization	for	actionable business insights.
Integrated real-time streaming (WebRTC with aiortc) into telecom solutions.
Automated processes with Linux shell scripting.
Designed and deployed Flask APIs; tested using Postman.
Started career with Java & React, later transitioned to Python and AI/ML.
Gained hands-on experience in EDA, text processing, an image/video processing, and object detection.
Built strong foundations in AI/ML fundamentals, leading to specialization in deep learning and applied ML.
PYTHON AND DATA HANDLING: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Data visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn), OOPs, error handling, logging, serialization, multithreading, and asynchronous programming, dependency management.
Applied statistics and EDA: Hypothesis Testing, Probability Distributions, Covariance & Correlation, Descriptive Statistics, Outlier Detection, Imbalanced Data Handling (SMOTE), Univariate/Bivariate/Multivariate Analysis, Data Scaling & Normalization, Text Pre-processing.
MACHINE LEARNING: Feature Engineering, Cross-validation, Hyperparameter tuning, Model selection, Dimensionality reduction, Supervised & Unsupervised learning Anomaly detection, Time-series forecasting, Ensemble methods, and Recommendation systems.
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI): Deep learning (TensorFlow, keras, neural networks), Com- puter vision (object detection, transfer learning), NLP (BERT, Spacy)
GENERATIVE AI (GenAI): LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, prompt engineering, Ollama, Bard, Rasa, vector stores, embeddings-based retrieval.
LLM MODELS & TOOLS:ChatGPT, Llama 2 & 3, Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, Mistral.
CLOUD & DEVELOPMENT: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, Terraform), GCP (Vertex AI, GCS, BigQue- ry), Docker, Application & ML Code Deployment, Model Training & Versioning.
DATABASES: MySQL, PostgreSQL, TinyDB, SQLAlchemy, Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB).
AUTOMATION & SCRIPTING: Linux, Shell Scripting, Cron Jobs, Workflow Automation.
API DEVELOPMENT & TESTING: Flask, FastAPI, Django, RESTful API Design, Swagger, Postman.
BI & VISUALIZATION TOOLS: Power BI, Looker Studio, Superset, Pyramid Analytics.
TOOLS & IDEs: Git, Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, Anaconda, Visual Studio.
